definitions: A technical analysis tool used to identify potential support and resistance levels in financial markets.
A method that uses horizontal lines to indicate areas of support or resistance at the key Fibonacci levels of 23.6%, 38.2%, 50%, 61.8%, and 100%.
examples: Traders often use Fibonacci retracement to predict price movements.
The analyst applied a Fibonacci retracement to the stock chart.
A Fibonacci retracement can help identify entry and exit points.
